column1: # Divergences for Petmate workspaces (.petmate); see README.md.

column4: RECOIL has no Petmate support and rejects every .petmate file. Structure from Petmate 9's own export code and file documentation (MIT); glyphs from the ROM character dumps in its assets. No reference render from another tool; the bundled test patterns (vdc_colorbars, c16_colorbars) label their own colours and character sets and our render matches those labels. Output reviewed: first screen of the workspace, no border.
